text: 中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记陈文清近日在全国扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议上强调，要扎实开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，依法清除一切侵蚀社会肌体的毒瘤，努力建设更高水平的平安中国，续写社会长期稳定新篇章。
text_en: Chen Wenqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, emphasized at a recent national video conference on the special campaign against organized crime that a one-year deepened special campaign against organized crime should be solidly carried out, legally eliminating all cancers that erode the social fabric, striving to build a higher level of Safe China, and continuing to write a new chapter of long-term social stability.
